name: polybridge-mcp
description: Read-only PolyBridge tools for Search, Forecast, and approved RVOL data access.
long_description:
PolyBridge MCP gives Claude Desktop probabilistic foresight from live prediction markets and approved read-only RVOL data access. Ask a question about the future, even when no exact market exists, or inspect approved realized-volatility model outputs when your PolyBridge API key includes rvol:read.

Search and Forecast can run without an API key at anonymous limits. Add POLYBRIDGE_API_KEY for higher Search/Forecast usage and for approved RVOL access. PolyBridge MCP is read-only. It does not trade or move funds.

POLYBRIDGE_ATTRIBUTION_CODE.title: Attribution code
POLYBRIDGE_ATTRIBUTION_CODE.description: Code sent with PolyBridge Search, Forecast, and RVOL API requests for builder attribution.

POLYBRIDGE_API_KEY.title: PolyBridge API key
POLYBRIDGE_API_KEY.description: Optional for Search and Forecast higher limits. Required for approved RVOL tools; the key must include rvol:read. Do not paste API keys into chat.

POLYBRIDGE_API_BASE_URL.title: PolyBridge API base URL
POLYBRIDGE_API_BASE_URL.description: Base URL for the PolyBridge Search, Forecast, and RVOL APIs.
